purpose: Reject weak daily equity and ETF trend-volatility hypotheses using a reproducible adjusted-price prototype. Results are development evidence only and cannot support promotion, a strategy grade, holdout access, paper trading, or live trading.

data.source_provider: Yahoo Finance public chart endpoint (legacy local copy)
data.corporate_action_status: provider adjusted-close series; independent corporate-action reconciliation is unavailable
data.decision_timestamp_convention: A daily adjusted-close observation is assumed usable only after the regular session. This convention is not independently verified and is inadequate for evidence-grade point-in-time claims.
data.survivorship_note: The fixed current ETF list is not a historical constituent reconstruction and may be survivorship-biased.

candidate.description: H01 252-bar sign trend forecast with H04 63-bar realized-volatility transform, 12% annualized target, 42 minimum return observations, 0.00 minimum and 1.50 maximum exposure multiplier.
candidate.portfolio_weighting: equal gross weight across the fixed six-instrument universe before each signal multiplier
candidate.shorting_assumption: Synthetic short exposure is an analytic position only; borrow availability and short financing are not modelled.

return_and_cost_convention.return_timing: A position decided after day t close earns the adjusted-close return from day t to t+1. This is a mark-to-market proxy, not a next-open execution simulation.
return_and_cost_convention.cost_limitations: No historical bid/ask, quote size, market impact, participation, borrow, taxes, or option costs are available. Cost scenarios are sensitivity assumptions only.

evaluation.unused_tail_bars: Any post-fold tail is retained in the snapshot but excluded from the prototype report; it is not a holdout and it has no acceptance role.
evaluation.inference_boundary: Metrics are descriptive falsification diagnostics. No significance test, alpha claim, Sharpe-ratio claim, promotion, or parameter selection is authorized.

forbidden_actions: options data retrieval or options strategy evaluation
candidate optimization or post-result parameter changes
comparison with or modification of the failed v1 campaign
new final-holdout creation, retrieval, or opening
